'''Bur''' was a [[Nomai]] from [[the Vessel]] who landed on [[Ember Twin]] with [[Hourglass_Twins#Escape_Pod_2|Escape Pod 2]].<ref>ANNONA: This is a relief, at least. You have my gratitude. Bur, were you able to find the other escape pods’ distress signals? BUR: I can hear both signals somewhere in this star system, but I don’t believe either escape pod crashed on the same planet as us.</ref>

==Escape Pod 2==
Upon landing on Ember Twin, [[Annona]] asked if Bur could find the other escape pods' distress signals.<ref>ANNONA: This is a relief, at least. You have my gratitude. Bur, were you able to find the other escape pods’ distress signals?</ref> Bur heard both signals somewhere in the star system but did not believe that they crashed on Ember Twin as well.<ref>BUR: I can hear both signals somewhere in this star system, but I don’t believe either escape pod crashed on the same planet as us.</ref>

==Life on Ember Twin==
Bur was an admirer of the [[Quantum Moon]], wondering where it disappeared to when it was not orbiting Ember Twin.<ref>BUR: I found your note, Melorae; kindly count me among this moon’s admirers! What is happening when it disappears (I doubt it ceases to exist)? Does it move to another location?</ref> They helped build the [[Hourglass_Twins#Quantum_Moon_Locator|Quantum Moon locator]], noting that sometimes the locator could not tell where the Quantum Moon was.<ref>BUR: I agree! Our first step would be determining a method to track this phantom moon so that we can always know where it is.</ref> They thought that perhaps there was a problem with the device, but [[Melorae]] proposed the idea that perhaps there was a [[Eye of the Universe|Sixth location]] that the moon travels to.<ref>BUR: I thought the locator now accounted for all of the phantom moon’s locations, but sometimes the locator can’t tell where the moon is. Perhaps there’s a problem with the device? MELORAE: It’s also possible there exists a sixth place in this star system to which the phantom moon travels.</ref>

At one point they traveled from their home in the [[Sunless City]] to help Melorae search for the missing [[Coleus]].<ref>BUR: Melorae, some of us from the Sunless City are here to help search for Coleus. Can you tell us more about your expedition?</ref>

== Trivia ==

* A ''[[Wikipedia:Bur|bur]]'' is a seed with hooks on the exterior, to catch on the fur of passing animals.
